summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding a fixed report concerning working hours/network. One participant confirmed the report was generally fine but noted an issue with the naming convention of the 'granulation' within the system, referencing a specific Jira ticket. The other participant acknowledged the error (incorrect translation) and stated they had renamed it. A follow-up request was made to confirm when the name change would be implemented in the system. Finally, the initial issue was confirmed as deployed.
decisions: The report regarding working hours/network is considered fine.
The naming convention error has been corrected and deployed.
